Slides.TextEn: For her birthday, Camila received a small cloth doll from her grandmother. At first she had been expecting an electronic toy and did not know what to say. Her grandmother told her that she had learned to sew dolls with her own mother and that each one had colors inspired by family memories. Camila looked at the stitches and discovered that no two were alike.
Slides.TextEs: Para su cumpleaños, Camila recibió de su abuela una pequeña muñeca de tela. Al principio esperaba un juguete electrónico y no supo qué decir. La abuela le contó que había aprendido a coser muñecas con su madre y que cada una llevaba colores inspirados en recuerdos familiares. Camila observó las puntadas y descubrió que ninguna era idéntica a otra.

Slides.TextEn: She asked to learn how to make one. For several afternoons they practiced together, making mistakes and laughing. When she finished, Camila gave her doll to a little cousin and told her the story of how it was made. She understood that some objects are valuable not for their price, but for the experiences and traditions they pass on.
Slides.TextEs: Pidió aprender a hacer una. Durante varias tardes practicaron juntas, equivocándose y riendo. Cuando terminó, Camila regaló su muñeca a una prima pequeña y le contó la historia de su creación. Comprendió que algunos objetos valen no por su precio, sino por las experiencias y tradiciones que transmiten.
